status_definitions.fresh: Inside the dataset's stated generation target.
status_definitions.delayed: Outside the target but not beyond twice the target.
status_definitions.available-reference: Reference data available without a daily freshness claim.
status_definitions.available-unversioned: Available without a reliable generation timestamp.

meta.count_semantics: record_count is dataset-specific; read it with purpose, role, quality, and caveat.
meta.publication_principle: Current assessments may fail closed; historical and reference data remain available only with actual coverage and limitations.
meta.additional_dependency_score_semantics: Added rows are optional visibility metadata. The established v1 required-dataset cohort and freshness denominator are unchanged.

datasets.status_reason: Reference data is available; no daily freshness claim is made

datasets.label: UAS platform catalog

datasets.status_reason: Reference data is available; no daily freshness claim is made

datasets.label: Indexed intelligence articles
datasets.purpose: What public reporting has the pipeline indexed for downstream flags, actor signals, and briefs?
datasets.caveat: This is not a complete media archive. Source availability, language coverage, syndication, and parser quality affect representation.

datasets.label: PIE intelligence flags
datasets.purpose: What current procurement, regulatory, supply-chain, and gray-zone signals deserve review?
datasets.caveat: Flags are analytic signals, not allegations or legal findings. Review sources, confidence, and status before acting.

datasets.label: PIE daily intelligence brief
datasets.purpose: What changed today, why does it matter, and what should be watched next?
datasets.caveat: The brief is a synthesis; underlying flags and cited sources remain the evidence of record.

datasets.label: PIE predictions
datasets.purpose: What explicit, time-bounded forecasts is PIE making?

quality.record_coverage_semantics: Earliest and latest parseable prediction creation/update timestamps; target dates are intentionally excluded.

datasets.caveat: Predictions are probabilistic judgments. Review calibration and resolved outcomes alongside open forecasts. Freshness reflects verification of the exact published artifact bytes; it does not imply that a new prediction, outcome, or evidence record was added.
datasets.freshness_timestamp_semantics: meta.generated_at is the content-integrity verification time for the exact artifact bytes and schema. It is not the date of a prediction, outcome, source, event, or newly collected evidence. Record-date coverage is separate.

datasets.label: PIE trend history
datasets.purpose: How have PIE's observed metrics changed over time?
datasets.caveat: History begins when snapshot accumulation started and is not necessarily backfilled to every source's beginning.

datasets.label: Threat actor public-source signals
datasets.purpose: Which tracked actors are mentioned in UAS reporting, and what context appears around those mentions?

quality.count_semantics: incident_count is retained for backward compatibility and equals article_mention_count. Neither field is a confirmed incident count.

datasets.caveat: Article mentions are not confirmed incidents or attribution. Boundary-aware matching reduces but does not eliminate false positives.

datasets.label: Duplicate-adjusted reporting and candidate-event clusters
datasets.purpose: How many distinct reporting groups and conservative candidate-event groups appear in the indexed UAS corpus?

units.candidate_event: conservative machine grouping of concrete, similar reporting

method.duplicate_adjustment: time-bounded exact titles; shared canonical URLs require substantial title agreement; cross-source only fuzzy-title matching
method.candidate_event_gate: explicit UAS-related event phrase, plausible publication date, shared event class, <=3-day window, and specific identifier/platform/content anchors
method.source_independence: unique site labels are a proxy only
method.component_span_control: connected reporting and candidate-event components are deterministically split so public temporal spans cannot exceed five and three days respectively
method.same_source_rolling_url_guard: different titles from the same source are never merged solely because they share a dashboard, feed, query, or rolling URL
method.same_source_candidate_event_guard: two reporting clusters containing only the same single source remain separate candidate events; source repetition is not corroboration
method.same_source_exact_title_guard: same-source exact titles require the same nonempty canonical story URL and the existing bounded publication-time agreement

datasets.caveat: Candidate events are deterministic machine groupings of public reporting, not confirmed incidents, formal attribution, or proof that sources are independent.

datasets.label: Open-source activity and exposure scores
datasets.purpose: Which actor signals warrant research priority based on activity, source diversity, TTP breadth, and weak defensive-procurement signal?

quality.score_semantics: Media-derived triage score. It summarizes actor-centered article mention volume, source diversity, context-matched TTP breadth, and weak indexed defensive-procurement signal. It is not an operational threat probability, capability estimate, or attribution.

datasets.caveat: This is a media-derived triage score, not an operational threat probability, capability estimate, or formal attribution.

datasets.label: Indexed defensive-procurement signal by TTP
datasets.purpose: Which UAS TTPs have weak or strong defensive-procurement evidence in the indexed corpus?
datasets.caveat: Missing keyword evidence means weak indexed signal, not proof that no capability or funding exists.

datasets.label: Adversary UAS teardown BOM analysis
datasets.purpose: Which observed components and countries appear in captured adversary UAS teardowns?
datasets.caveat: Coverage is limited to publicly documented samples and does not represent every batch or variant.

datasets.label: Component mirroring index
datasets.purpose: Which Western-funded entities have component-type profiles resembling documented adversary platforms?
datasets.caveat: Similarity is a research lead, not proof of transfer, diversion, or misconduct. Empty output can reflect alignment limits.

datasets.label: Sanctions-evasion relationship signals
datasets.purpose: Which entities connect to tracked gray-zone seeds through shared public relationships?
datasets.caveat: Graph proximity is an analytic signal, not an allegation. Co-mention is weaker than ownership, investment, program, or component evidence.

datasets.label: PIE market lens
datasets.purpose: How does PIE coverage line up descriptively with public market data?
datasets.caveat: Descriptive comparison only; not investment advice and not evidence of causation.

datasets.label: Resolved prediction outcomes
datasets.purpose: Which forecasts have been graded, and what evidence resolved them?

quality.record_coverage_semantics: Earliest and latest parseable outcome resolution/scoring timestamps.

datasets.caveat: Grading depends on available public evidence and documented resolution rules. Freshness reflects verification of the exact published artifact bytes; it does not imply that a new prediction, outcome, or evidence record was added.
datasets.freshness_timestamp_semantics: meta.generated_at is the content-integrity verification time for the exact artifact bytes and schema. It is not the date of a prediction, outcome, source, event, or newly collected evidence. Record-date coverage is separate.

datasets.label: Prediction calibration scores
datasets.purpose: Are PIE's stated probabilities calibrated against resolved outcomes?
datasets.caveat: Calibration is unstable when the resolved sample is small; sample size must be read with the score.

quality.refresh_semantics: generated_at advances only when the publication gate observes at least the configured number of live sources. Cached rows are retained for availability and disclosed by source; they are not represented as newly collected evidence.
quality.source_independence_caveat: Source labels identify collection channels and do not prove publisher, award, or reporting independence. Verify each linked authoritative source.

datasets.label: Pipeline source health
datasets.purpose: Which collectors are reporting on schedule, and where are ingestion gaps?
datasets.caveat: A healthy collector means the job reported; it does not guarantee complete upstream coverage or zero parser drift.

datasets.label: Public source and collection coverage matrix
datasets.purpose: What sources, publication periods, metadata fields, languages/scripts, geographies, and collection gaps are actually represented in the indexed corpus?

recent_windows.semantics: Publication-date presence within the window; missing days do not prove no collection ran or no event occurred.
Publication-date presence within the window; missing days do not prove no collection ran or no event occurred.

quality.language_semantics: Language counts use only explicit record metadata. Script signals are Unicode character-family observations and do not identify a language. Latin-script does not mean English.
quality.geography_semantics: Registered geography is the registry's source focus/location label. Explicit article geography is counted only from structured article fields. Candidate-event regions are keyword-derived mentions. None is a full geopolitical coverage or event-location assessment.
quality.temporal_semantics: Coverage dates are article publication dates, not collector run times or event occurrence dates. Missing publication days do not prove a miner did not run or that no relevant activity occurred.
quality.source_semantics: Source keys and site labels are collection buckets, not verified independent publishers. Syndication and shared ownership can remain.

datasets.caveat: Observed collection coverage only. Source keys are not guaranteed independent publishers; publication gaps do not prove a collector did not run or no event occurred; language and geography metadata are incomplete.

datasets.label: Transparent PIE data-quality rating
datasets.purpose: How fit, current, attributable, diverse, and accountable are the public PIE datasets today?
datasets.caveat: This score rates data fitness and accountability, not whether every analytical claim is true. Inspect each dimension's formula and component counts.

datasets.label: Reviewed maintenance intelligence advisories
datasets.purpose: Which evidence-backed public observations have passed analyst review for installed-component assessment in Hangar?

quality.decision_semantics: Analyst-approved advisory publication only; installed impact requires a separate Hangar decision.

datasets.caveat: Advisories are non-authorizing review inputs. They neither identify an installed match nor change airworthiness, readiness, or execution authority.

datasets.label: Evidence-linked entity dossiers
datasets.purpose: Which explicit source records connect actors, platforms, components and current flags?

quality.relationship_semantics: Explicit structured IDs/names and curated exact aliases. No title substring or fuzzy containment relationships. Structured upstream entity extraction may still be wrong; inspect the referenced record.
quality.timestamp_semantics: generated_at is graph construction time. Per-record publication, event, verification and collection dates retain their input meanings. Rebuilding does not refresh old evidence.

datasets.caveat: Structured source associations and curated exact aliases, not verified corporate relationships. Graph generation does not refresh its reference evidence.
